title: Local response theory of multiparameter sudden-quench quantum Otto engines
summary: Multiparameter quantum Otto engines raise an optimization problem absent in single-parameter cycles: which small quench vector maximizes the quadratic approximation to the exact output work in a multidimensional control space? We develop a local response theory for sudden-quench Otto engines with quantum working media described by linearly controlled Hamiltonians. We show that the local quadratic work decomposes into a thermal-bias gain and a quadratic response cost, whose competition determines the quench vector that maximizes the local quadratic work at a prescribed quench amplitude.
